item.title: ‘Social media first’ culture hinders fire rescues
item.description: Delayed fire reporting is costing lives and increasing property damage. Standing Committee on Social Affairs member Aliki Bia expressed concern that some people prioritize posting fires on social media over calling the National Fire Authority, critically stalling emergency responses.
